seo_title: Stay | River tents, bush tents and a log cabin | Mara River Camp
seo_description: River tents on the bank of the Mara River, bush tents with private terraces and Simba's Den, a two-bedroom log cabin with a deck over the water. Exploreans Mara River Camp, Maasai Mara.
label: Stay
title: Sleep to the sound of the river
lead: Canvas and timber under the trees of the riverbank. Every tent and the cabin has its own terrace or deck, an en-suite bathroom and turndown every evening.
alt: The wide brown water of the Mara River between wooded banks, below the camp

in_camp.title: The deck and the pool
in_camp.body: A swimming pool among the trees, with sunbeds and shade for the middle of the day.

in_camp.title: The Zebra Bar
in_camp.body: Poolside by day and beside the fire in the evening, open until the last guest calls it a night.

in_camp.title: At the table
in_camp.body: Breakfast, lunch and dinner in the garden or on the deck, with local, Asian and international dishes from the camp kitchen.

in_camp.title: Around camp
in_camp.body: Wi-Fi throughout, a gift shop, laundry and a medical service.
